column1: # Human rulings on the TWDA reconciliation, and the only hand-authored input to
# it. `reconcile_twda.py` reads this, applies it over what the matchers derive,
# and writes twda_decisions.tsv — which is generated, so never edit that one.
#     Overrides the event matcher for one archive entry. `create` means we
#     checked and do not hold it.
#     Binds an archive winner spelling to a member. The name is matched
#     normalised (casefolded, ASCII-folded, punctuation dropped), so the exact
#     capitalisation and accents here are documentation.
# A winner ruling is an identity claim about a real person. Every uid below was
# checked to exist and to carry the name claimed for it.
# --- events: the twelve the reconciliation queue could not settle (owner, 2026-08-16)
# --- winners: 23 of the 50 the matchers left open (owner, 2026-08-16)
# --- winners: the crowded-surname holdback, confirmed on sight (owner, 2026-08-17)
# The surname-anchored classes proposed each of these and were refused by
# MAX_SHARING_SURNAME, because the surname is shared by 4 to 106 members and the
# given name was carrying the whole claim. Confirmed, so they are rulings now
# rather than a gate loosened for everybody.
